basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon, who is passionate about wildlife, especially reptiles. I spend my free time caring for my leopard gecko and exploring tech gadgets. I've struggled with anxiety and have been in recovery from benzodiazepine dependency for over a year. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and find solace in online communities during the pandemic.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a keen interest in technology, which I nurture through online courses and forums. My experience with benzo recovery is personal, learned through rehabilitation and community support groups. I also have self-taught knowledge about reptile care from various online resources and communities.
